card.name: "No" before cure or antidote
card.fires_on: The word "no" (or "a", "known", "specific") in phrases like "there is no" just before a word such as cure, antidote or treatment. It appears in disease descriptions and overdose sections.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "cure" and related words after the "no" phrase.
card.plain: It notices a sentence saying there is no cure or antidote and prepares to say that word.
